scope: exploratory policy tuning of historical models on a shared frozen validation cohort
score_modes: whole_window and latest_reading for each LSTM; anomaly score for Isolation Forest
quantile_fit: fully known normal validation histories only
pr_fit: validation only; global score threshold; exact ties follow >= semantics
two_of_three_definition: at least two highs in three complete consecutive eligible readings; current reading need not be high
reset: any node change or gap between eligible scored timestamps
notification_demonstration: 60-minute cooldown on rising edges, separate from raw decisions; reset at gaps/nodes
selection: Among feasible validation policies, maximize precision, then F0.5, then minimize false-burst rate, then maximize recall. If none feasible, report no feasible policy; do not relax targets silently.
training_caveat: Historical training sets and early-stopping periods differ. This is a diagnostic on identical validation endpoints, not the primary retrained-model comparison.
